A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research and contain matching main sections and Appendices A–D. Text extraction and visual inspection support reliable comparison of their equations, tables, figures, and appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original knowledge-localization, personalization, and unlearning experiments, including quantitative plots, generated examples, and the brute-force comparison in Appendix B.2.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, with some changes to the displayed qualitative examples.

M1.justification: Attention-contribution ranking, top-K prompt interventions, localized DreamBooth fine-tuning, and anchor-based unlearning remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six LOCK categories, personalization subjects, and COCO image-quality setting. Removing celebrity illustrations from Figure 1 does not remove celebrity coverage, which remains in Figures 4, 12, and 13.

E2.justification: Both retain full-model DreamBooth, full-model unlearning following Kumari et al., the brute-force block-window baseline in Appendix B.2, and the no-intervention/full-intervention references in Figure 12.

E3.justification: LOCK splits, evaluation metrics, the 10,000-sample COCO FID subset, and fine-tuning settings are unchanged. Personalization still updates nine blocks and unlearning five; Figure 4 retains intervention levels of 0%, 10%, 30%, and 50%.

E4.justification: The qualitative intervention cases receive a limited revision: Figure 1 removes celebrity pairs, and Figure 4 replaces the Einstein K-sensitivity sequence with a tiger sequence. The other K-sensitivity evidence and Appendix B.3's artistic-style analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: The statement about averaging across seeds and prompts and the plotted uncertainty displays are unchanged. v2 adds no run counts, uncertainty-estimation procedures, or statistical tests.

E6.justification: Figure 1 removes two celebrity generation/intervention pairs, and Figure 4 replaces four Einstein outputs with tiger outputs. Numerical results remain unchanged, including Appendix B.2's CSD scores of 0.7669 for brute-force localization and 0.7781 for the proposed method.

T1.justification: The attention-contribution equations, diffusion and flow formulations in Appendix A.1, and unlearning KL objective and diffusion loss in Appendix C.2 are unchanged. No formal assumptions or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same localization claims, LOCK dataset contribution, and claimed efficiency and preservation benefits of localized personalization and unlearning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of architectural and artistic-style differences remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the limitations concerning external evaluation for selecting K and the lack of ground-truth localization benchmarks.

D1.justification: Dataset-construction details, script references, project-page access information, and Appendix C.3.1's hyperparameters, image resolution, gradient clipping, and RTX A6000 disclosure are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 lists arXiv:2406.07844 twice under different titles, with the same authors, as references 37 and 38. This duplicates an existing cited work rather than adding research coverage. Related-work arguments and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds Adobe as a second affiliation for Samyadeep Basu and makes bibliographic and citation-number edits. Main-text and appendix prose, terminology, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 removes the Celebrity panel and rearranges the remaining overview. Figure 4 replaces one image sequence while retaining its plots and layout. Other figures and both tables retain their presentation.

improvement.justification: Figure 4's tiger sequence illustrates an already evaluated category, while celebrity evidence remains in Figures 12–13 despite removal of main-text examples. Methods, quantitative support, limitations, and reproducibility information are unchanged. The limited illustration edits, affiliation update, and duplicate bibliography entry produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
